picks.title: Why Socrates Would Hate AI | 391
picks.summary:
AI seems to be everywhere at the moment. You can’t go a single day without someone posting about how AI sped up their work and solved all their problems. But with every technology there are downsides that aren’t apparent when it first shows up. Today we’re going to talk about some of those downsides from a Stoic perspective and consider what Socrates might think of AI.
“No man was ever wise by chance.” — Seneca

picks.title: Krishnamurti on Concepts
picks.summary:
‘We have built a conceptual world, a world based on ideas, a world based on a philosophy which is essentially material.’
This episode on Concepts has three sections.
The first extract (2:25) is from the fifth talk in Madras 1980, and is titled: Why Do We Live On Concepts?
The second extract (31:32) is from Krishnamurti’s sixth talk in Saanen 1974, and is titled: Is There Security in Concepts?
The final extract in this episode (50:24) is from the first talk in Amsterdam 1967, and is titled: Seeing Without Concepts.
The Krishnamurti Podcast features carefully selected extracts from his talks. Ea
picks.reason: Krishnamurti critiques conceptual thinking and security in ideas.
